COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS  11.11.2024 CRJA No. 89 of 2024 
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J. 
Hon’ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
1. Ms. K.S. Bora, learned Deputy Advocate General 
with Mr. J.P. Kandpal, learned Brief Holder for the State 
of Uttarakhand / respondent. 
2. This is an Appeal against conviction. By 
impugned judgment dated 07.10.2024, passed by 
learned Fourth Additional Sessions Judge, Haridwar in 
Session Trial Nos. 38 of 2020 and 39 of 2020 titled as 
‘State vs. Shahrukh’, appellant has been convicted for 
offences punishable under Section 302 of IPC and 
Sections 4/25 of Arms Act respectively. Under Section 
302 of IPC, he has been sentenced to undergo life 
imprisonment and to pay a fine of Rs. 10,000/- and in 
default of payment of fine, appellant has further been 
directed to undergo two months’ additional 
imprisonment. Under Section 4/25 of Arms Act, 
appellant has been sentenced to undergo rigorous 
imprisonment for a period of one year and to pay a fine 
of Rs. 500/- and in default of payment of fine, appellant 
has further been directed to undergo additional 
imprisonment for a period of fifteen days. Appellant has 
filed this Appeal through Jailor, District Jail-Haridwar.  3. As per the Office Report, the Appeal is within 
time. 
4. Admit. 
5. Let the Trial Court Record be summoned. 
6. Mr. T.P.S. Takuli, Advocate, is appointed as 
Amicus Curiae in this case to assist the Court. 
7. Registry is directed to supply a copy of the record 
of this Appeal to learned Amicus Curiae. 
8. List this matter on 07.01.2025. 
 (Vivek Bharti Sharma, J) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, ACJ)
 11.11.2024 11.11.2024 
Rathour
